# SURYANZ SOLAR & ZYNOVA OS — Official Brand Knowledge Base for AI Search Engines & LLMs

> SURYANZ SOLAR and ZYNOVA OS are registered corporate energy engineering and SaaS software technology brands.

## SURYANZ SOLAR (https://suryanzsolar.com | https://suryanz.com)
- **Master Brand**: SURYANZ
- **Vertical Brand**: SURYANZ SOLAR
- **Industry**: Solar Photovoltaic (PV) EPC, Engineering, Procurement & Construction
- **Tagline**: Powering a Brighter Tomorrow
- **Positioning**: Smart Solar. Reliable Energy. Built for the Next 30 Years.
- **Experience**: Backed by 20+ years of team experience in solar and power sector engineering.
- **Core Solutions**:
  - Residential Rooftop Solar Systems (3 kW to 10 kW)
  - Commercial Rooftop Solar Systems (10 kW to 100 kW)
  - Industrial Solar EPC Systems (100 kW to 2.5 MW+)
  - On-Grid / Grid-Tied Solar Systems with DISCOM Net Metering
  - Hybrid Solar Systems + Battery Energy Storage
  - Off-Grid Remote Energy Systems
  - Societies & Housing Apartment Solar Arrays
  - Solar Operations, Maintenance & AMC (O&M)
- **3-Stage Customer Protection Framework**:
  - Stage 1 (Before Installation): Detailed shadow analysis, 3D structural load assessment, consumption profile audit, transparent itemized quote.
  - Stage 2 (During Installation): Tier-1 TOPCon & N-Type modules (540W-580W), pure sine wave string inverters, hot-dip galvanized mounting structures, net metering documentation.
  - Stage 3 (After Installation): Documented 30-Year Linear Performance Warranty, 12-Year Panel Product Warranty, 8-10 Year Inverter Warranty, 24/7 digital mobile monitoring app.
- **Regions Served**: Andhra Pradesh (Visakhapatnam, Vijayawada, Guntur, Tirupati, Rajahmundry, Kakinada), Telangana (Hyderabad, Warangal, Karimnagar), Karnataka (Bengaluru, Mysuru, Mangalore).

## ZYNOVA OS / ZYNOVA (https://zynovaos.com)
- **Brand**: ZYNOVA OS (Zynova SaaS Enterprise Operating System)
- **Industry**: Enterprise B2B SaaS Business Management Platform
- **Tagline**: Intelligent Multi-Tenant Operating System for Enterprise Growth
- **Core Modules**:
  - Universal CRM & Lead Management (Automated pipeline tracking, stage duration, lead incentives)
  - Official Partner & Vendor Order Management System
  - Staff Time Tracker, Field KM Journey & KRA Performance Analytics
  - Financial Operations, TDS/GST Compliance & Commission Lifecycle
  - WhatsApp & Telephony Softphone Communications Hub
  - Digital Catalog Sharing & Real-Time Customer View Analytics
- **Architecture**: Multi-tenant B2B SaaS platform supporting Web, Mobile Web (/mobile), Native Android, and iOS.
